name: BattleTech Trading Card Game
customHelp: BattleTech TCG phases: Untap, Draw 2, Deploy, Repair/Reload, Missions, End. Draw 5 cards to begin. Damage to a Stockpile scraps that many cards; a player wins when an opponent's Stockpile is empty.

mulliganCycle.info: BattleTech TCG Mulligan: Reshuffle your entire hand and draw one fewer card. You may repeat this procedure, down to a hand of zero cards.
London Mulligan: Draw five cards again each time you mulligan. When you keep, put one card on the bottom of your deck for each mulligan you took.

postMulligan.info: Select one card for each mulligan you took, then put the selected cards on the bottom of your deck.

mulliganCycle.info: Free Mulligan: Reshuffle your entire hand and draw five new cards. You may repeat this procedure without reducing your hand size.
